senses.gloss: פ׳ דמרא blade of the hoe (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Ascia); [comment. the club, handle of the hoe].

units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 27b:12">B. Kam. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>שקל פ׳ דמ׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. a. Ms. H. (ed. <he>פנ׳</he>) he took a hoe and struck him.—Pl. <he>פַּדֵּי</he> (<he>פַּנְדֵּי</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 27b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>מאה פ׳ בפדא וכ׳</he> he ought to have given him a hundred blows with the hoe.
